Glaucoma and ocular hypertension. Topical beta blockers are often the drugs of first choice for the initial treatment and maintenance of open-angle glaucoma and other chronic glauco- mas (p.1873). They are believed to inhibit beta receptors in the ciliary epithelium and reduce the secretion of aqueous humour.
